name: Rating
label: Rating
description: Star-scale rating control with keyboard selection, a read-only mode, and a configurable icon.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial rating for uncontrolled use. 0 means no rating.

props.name: max
props.description: Number of steps on the scale

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the new rating directly.
Fires on every selection, including a clear back to 0 via `allowClear`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Display-only mode — renders the current rating with no interaction

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Selecting the already-selected step clears the rating back to 0

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph drawn for each step — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode). A string glyph solidifies on filled steps via the font's fill axis; a custom element should draw with `currentColor` so the filled colour still reads.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, and the base of each step's label

props.name: valueLabel
props.description:
The spoken value, given a step (or, in `readOnly` mode, the current
rating) and `max`. Defaults to "3 out of 5". It follows `label` and a
colon, as in "Rating: 3 out of 5".
